notes: Lowest kept spots have 0 views but 1-3 counted sources (no Wikipedia article for Waikanae Beach, Wellington Waterfront, Aratoi), so views alone make most left-out items "stronger". Review verdicts (marginal) need owner approval; none was dropped for placement reasons.
